sv.title: Kokain i kalsongerna – nu vill polisen ta Malmöbons pengar
sv.summary: Kontanter i garderoben, 200 000 kronor på sparkontot och mängder av falska märkeskläder. Polisen började granska en ung Malmöbos ekonomi sedan han gripits med kokain i kalsongerna. Nu vill de ta hans pengar. De falska märkeskläderna får han behålla.

en.title: Cocaine in his underwear – now police want Malmö man's money
en.summary: Cash in the wardrobe, SEK 200,000 in a savings account and large quantities of counterfeit designer clothing. Police began examining the finances of a young Malmö man after he was arrested with cocaine in his underwear. Now they want his money. He is allowed to keep the counterfeit designer clothes.
